bindings.NATIVE_RECEIPT: Only with exact repository SHA, run ID, attempt, job, verified artifact member hash
bindings.ROLE_ONLY: Canonical responsibility, not evidence of an execution
bindings.DECLARED: Source-defined intended interface; must render dashed
bindings.DESIGN_ONLY: Proposed local/testflight dependency; must render dashed

status_classes.HISTORICAL_PASS: Source-bound earlier native proof, never live
status_classes.DECLARED: Defined process relationship without native trigger
status_classes.ALIAS: Graph placement duplicate sharing canonical identity
status_classes.NATIVE_REQUIRED: Next run requires exact runner job/attempt

unknown_semantics: null means missing/unknown; not zero, not green
private_qps_publication: METADATA_ONLY, zero private child source payload

visual_engines.pptx: read-only snapshot from same semantic JSON

sampling_guard: PCA and BT qualify only with enough independent comparable samples and a connected pairwise design

PROGRAMMES.historical_interpretation: Preserve historical source spelling and meaning. Normalize aliases only in explicitly typed new programme fields; do not rewrite old artifacts.

records.label: GoGREEN
records.purpose: Observe source-bound successful behavior, verify its evidence, widen proof and plan bounded resilience and coverage experiments.
records.authority_boundary: PASS is an observation. New failures return to the source root owner; a programme label does not prove current-head admission or statistical stability.

records.label: EVERRED
records.purpose: Recurring health census and root-cause repair: harvest, classify, assign one root/owner, repair, verify, admit, control and recur.
records.authority_boundary: Occurrences, signatures, candidate roots and independently accepted root closures remain separate. Standing cadence in the method is not proof of a running monitor.

records.label: CODE PURPLE
records.purpose: Govern critical quality, evidence and admission recovery; in the P process, concentrate bounded resources on an acute owner-declared blocker.
records.authority_boundary: Existing incident entry, lift and inherited-root handoff rules remain source-owned. A colour or tag does not activate incident mode, break glass, waive gates or authorize release.

records.label: CODE MAROON
records.purpose: Classify review and security debt with separate source receipts, manifestation/fingerprint deduplication and closed, deferred and outstanding dispositions.
records.authority_boundary: The local sources describe the review-security instance. Preserve scanner/SARIF and review provenance independently; this mapping establishes neither current counts nor automatic finding closure.

records.label: JADE TEMPLE
records.purpose: Provide programme continuity, shared instructions, human review artifacts and navigation for owner-defined release-candidate preparation.
records.authority_boundary: Uses existing cohort, root ledger, scheduler and Pages publisher. QPS and each repository retain their own acceptance and release authority.

records.label: JADE CASTE
records.purpose: Describe the source-bound repository readiness ladder J0 inventoried, J1 navigable, J2 published, J3 governed candidate, J4 release ready and J5 owner released.
records.authority_boundary: Bare JADE does not identify a level. J4 is candidate qualification; J5 needs independently supported owner release. Unknown applicability remains explicit.

records.label: P process
records.purpose: Coordinate acute CODE_PURPLE and recurring EVERRED modes using the existing incident escalation, lift and inherited-root handoff contract.
records.authority_boundary: p_process.yaml and p_decide.py own the transition logic. This taxonomy is a projection and does not create a second mode controller.

records.label: B&B / Bread & Butter
records.authority_boundary: Requested programme label retained for discovery. No authoritative definition or code binding was found in the current checkout; do not infer that it means CODE_PURPLE, JADE, CBD! or ordinary maintenance.

JADE.rule: Resolve the intended member or preserve the family label; never infer readiness from the family.

composition.rule: Programme tags may compose as a set; method, execution unit, priority, health, readiness and evidence remain orthogonal fields. Composition does not sum populations or transfer authority.

examples.meaning: A security-root workstream inside a governed three-pulse recovery wave; observed and accepted root counts retain their source scopes.
Refresh, probe and rank positive evidence for repository readiness during three measured pulses; neither a PASS nor a pulse increments J-level automatically.

composition.alias_scope: Only programme/family fields; palette colours, old filenames, bare P1/P2/P3, bare W labels and method aliases are not programme identities.
composition.unknown_rule: Preserve unresolved label, source and null meaning; exclude it from dispatch predicates until a source-owned mapping exists.

execution_hierarchy.identity_rule: Qualify repository, mission and wave; keep sprint_id as planning context, pulse_id distinct from priority, and native run_id/run_attempt/job_id distinct from logical worker IDs.
execution_hierarchy.counts: A sprint contains one or more waves; a wave coordinates pulses; a pulse may have zero or more runs, including an explicit blocked disposition.
execution_hierarchy.G3P: One wave envelope with exactly three ordered pulse slots; not three waves or three accepted advances.
execution_hierarchy.3MP: Three source-bound measurement/improvement pulse dispositions; HOLD may complete a pulse without acceptance.
execution_hierarchy.3W: Three distinct delivery waves; each has its own outcome and pulse accounting.
execution_hierarchy.G3A: Target three independently accepted advances, stopping at a major blocker.
execution_hierarchy.ordinal_rule: Increment n_pulse only for a qualified disposition record and n_accepted only for separately qualified acceptance; never derive either from worker, test, PR or run totals.

view_semantics.SPINE: Source/process/identity/node/evidence navigation lens; inherits the existing proposed view label and is not a new canonical method.
view_semantics.SPLINE: Time-aligned descriptive trend over source-comparable observations. Unknowns are gaps; a line is not a causal claim or forecast.
view_semantics.DAG: Acyclic projection of explicitly selected dependency edges for one execution scope. Reference, ownership and next-pulse feedback do not automatically become prerequisites.
view_semantics.SIPOC: Keep all five roles and bind output artifact ports to compatible next-process input ports. Customer/supplier actor continuity is a separate handover relationship.
view_semantics.display_rule: Programme palette, execution status, evidence class and edge type each need their own legend; purple grouping is topology, not progress.
